feoff.definition: n a piece of land held under the feudal system
feoff.translation:
n. 采邑, 封地
vt. 授予封地

feoffed.translation: v. 授予封地( feoff的过去式和过去分词 )

feoffee.definition:
n. The person to whom a feoffment is made; the person
   enfeoffed.
feoffee.translation: n. 受采邑者, 封地受领人

feoffees.definition:
plural of feoffee
n. The person to whom a feoffment is made; the person
   enfeoffed.
feoffees.translation: (feoffee 的复数) n. 受采邑者, 封地受领人

feoffer.definition: n. One who enfeoffs or grants a fee.
feoffer.translation: n. 采邑授与人, 不动产赠与人

feoffing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Feoff
feoffing.translation: v. 授予封地( feoff的现在分词 )

feoffment.definition:
n. The grant of a feud or fee.
n. A gift or conveyance in fee of land or other corporeal
   hereditaments, accompanied by actual delivery of possession.
n. The instrument or deed by which corporeal hereditaments
   are conveyed.

feoffor.translation:
n. 采邑授与人, 不动产赠与人
[法] 不动产授与人, 封地授与人

feosol.definition: n trade name of a drug rich in iron; used to treat some kinds of anemia
feosol.translation: [医] 费奥索(一种硫酸亚铁制剂)
